bio: Michael Joseph Rogers (born June 2, 1963) is an American politician and former Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) agent who served from 2001 to 2015 as the U.S. representative for Michigan's 8th congressional district. A member of the Republican Party, he chaired the United States House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence from 2011 to 2015.
offices: Member of the State Senate of Michigan (1995–2001)
